notes.title: Fixed major problems in Tsukichi's demo
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi, I've fixed most of the problems of Tsukichis demo, I'd love it if you'd give it another try![/h1]

The biggest problem was maybe the attacks' audio being too loud and having a too powerful base. Fixed ✅
The traps were too powerful and resulted in instant death. Fixed ✅
The health orb that gets released by the baby mushrooms didn't point show in the log that it restores health and mana. Fixed ✅
There were some dialogues not showing, the most important being the tutorial on how to use the "Skill". Fixed ✅
The enemies had too much health, if the went behind objects it was hard to see them, when they spawned they started out in idle mode, and the shader was glitching. Fixed ✅
When fighting behind the columns and chains, it was hard to target the enemies properly because the character would aim towards the column. Fixed ✅
